```{r}
# Load required libraries
library(lme4)    # For mixed effects models
library(simr)    # For power analysis
library(ggplot2) # For plotting
library(dplyr)   # For data manipulation
library(tidyr)   # For reshaping data
library(lmerTest)
```
Load and clean heatmap trials data
```{r}
suppressPackageStartupMessages(library(here))
source(here::here("analysis", "scripts", "00_setup.R"))

if (!file.exists(cfg$out_clean_heatmap)) {
  stop("Run 01_clean_trials.R first.")
}

heatmap <- readRDS(cfg$out_clean_heatmap) %>%
  mutate(attention = factor(attention, levels = c("single", "dual")))

eligible_ids <- heatmap %>%
  filter(!exclude_tier1) %>%
  distinct(participant_id) %>%
  pull(participant_id)

heatmap_filtered <- heatmap %>%
  filter(participant_id %in% eligible_ids)

# Duration-based outlier exclusion
# 1) Exclude participants whose mean duration is outside +/- 2 SD of
#    the distribution of participant mean durations.
# 2) Within the remaining participants, exclude trials outside +/- 2 SD
#    of each participant's own mean duration.
duration_col <- if ("duration" %in% names(heatmap_filtered)) {
  "duration"
} else if ("response_time" %in% names(heatmap_filtered)) {
  "response_time"
} else {
  stop("No duration-like column found. Need `duration` or `response_time`.")
}

heatmap_filtered <- heatmap_filtered %>%
  mutate(duration_for_filter = as.numeric(.data[[duration_col]])) %>%
  filter(!is.na(duration_for_filter), is.finite(duration_for_filter))

participant_duration <- heatmap_filtered %>%
  group_by(participant_id) %>%
  summarise(mean_duration = mean(duration_for_filter, na.rm = TRUE), .groups = "drop")

group_mean_duration <- mean(participant_duration$mean_duration, na.rm = TRUE)
group_sd_duration <- sd(participant_duration$mean_duration, na.rm = TRUE)

participant_keep <- participant_duration %>%
  mutate(
    keep_participant = mean_duration >= (group_mean_duration - 2 * group_sd_duration) &
      mean_duration <= (group_mean_duration + 2 * group_sd_duration)
  ) %>%
  filter(keep_participant) %>%
  pull(participant_id)

### THIS IS FOR EXCLUDING OUTLIERS
```

### fit the model
```{r}
if (!all(c("attention_c", "label_condition_c", "lightness_mapping_c", "block_num") %in% names(heatmap_filtered))) {
  stop("Missing centralized contrast/block columns. Re-run analysis/scripts/01_clean_trials.R.")
}
heatmap_filtered$block_c <- scale(heatmap_filtered$block_num, center = TRUE, scale = FALSE)[, 1]


m1_all_blocks <- glmer(
  correct ~ label_condition_c*lightness_mapping_c*attention_c*block_c +
    (1 + label_condition_c*lightness_mapping_c + block_c | participant_id), 
  data = heatmap_filtered,
  family = binomial("logit"),
  control = glmerControl(optimizer = "bobyqa")
)

summary(m1_all_blocks)

# Model using only first two blocks (stimuli_number 0-39)
heatmap_first2 <- heatmap_filtered %>%
  dplyr::filter(!is.na(block_num), block_num <= 2)

m1_first2_blocks <- glmer(
  correct ~ label_condition_c*lightness_mapping_c*attention_c +
    (1 + label_condition_c*lightness_mapping_c | participant_id), 
  data = heatmap_first2,
  family = binomial("logit"),
  control = glmerControl(optimizer = "bobyqa")
)

summary(m1_first2_blocks)

```

### Simulation using mixedpower

```{r}
if (!require("devtools")) {
    install.packages("devtools", dependencies = TRUE)}
devtools::install_github("DejanDraschkow/mixedpower") # mixedpower is hosted on GitHub

# load library
library(mixedpower)

model <- m1_all_blocks # use first-two-block model for power simulation
heatmap_filtered$participant_id_num <- as.numeric(factor(heatmap_filtered$participant_id))
data <- heatmap_filtered # data used to fit the model
fixed_effects <- c("label_condition_c","lightness_mapping_c","attention_c","block_c")
simvar <- "participant_id_num" # which random effect do we want to vary in the simulation?


# SIMULATION PARAMETERS
steps <- c(20, 40, 60, 80, 100) # which sample sizes do we want to look at?
critical_value <- 1.96 # which t/z value do we want to use to test for significance?
n_sim <- 50 # how many single simulations should be used to estimate power?


power_analysis_results <- mixedpower(model = model, data = data,
                        fixed_effects = fixed_effects,
                        simvar = simvar, steps = steps,
                        critical_value = critical_value, n_sim = n_sim)

power_analysis_results

# multiplotPower(power_analysis_results)
multiplotPower(power_analysis_results, ppi = 300, filename = "../output/power_analysis3_acc_wBlock_woExclusions.png")

```
